gloss: sweet bean paste; thick starchy sauce

definitions.gloss: sweet bean paste, red bean paste, filling (for wagashi)
definitions.explanation: Most commonly refers to sweet paste made from azuki beans, used in Japanese confections. Can be smooth (koshi-an) or chunky (tsubu-an).
Refers to thickened sauces used in Chinese and Japanese cuisine, often made with starch.

notes:
{餡|あん} has two distinct meanings depending on context: sweet bean paste used in ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧ (Japanese confections), and savory thickened sauce used in cooking.

SENSE 1 — SWEET BEAN PASTE:
Made from ⟦{小豆|あずき}→小豆：10209_azuki⟧ (azuki beans), this is the most common filling in Japanese sweets.

Types:
- {粒餡|つぶあん}: chunky bean paste (beans partially intact)
- {漉|こ}し{餡|あん}: smooth bean paste (strained)
- {白餡|しろあん}: white bean paste (from white beans)

Found in: ⟦{大福|だいふく}→大福：12173_daifuku⟧, ⟦{饅頭|まんじゅう}→饅頭：05000_manjuu⟧, ⟦{鯛焼|たいや}き→鯛焼き：10363_taiyaki⟧, ⟦{羊羹|ようかん}→羊羹：05002_youkan⟧

SENSE 2 — THICK SAUCE:
A starchy sauce made with ⟦{片栗粉|かたくりこ}→片栗粉：04923_katakuriko⟧ (potato starch), used in Chinese-influenced Japanese dishes.
- ⟦{餡|あん}かけ→餡かけ：28727_ankake⟧: dish topped with thick sauce
- ⟦{餡|あん}かけ→餡かけ：28727_ankake⟧⟦{焼|や}きそば→焼きそば：13405_yakisoba⟧: fried noodles with thick sauce

WRITING:
Also commonly written in hiragana as あん.
